reportData.name: ReportData
reportData.description: The ReportData object enables the retrieval of single reports or filtered collections of reports.

fields.name: report
fields.description: Obtain a specific report by its code.

args.name: code
args.description: Required. The code of a single report to retrieve.

args.name: allowUnlisted
args.description: Optional. Whether to allow viewing of unlisted logs. If you have a multi-user application where you cache codes, set this to true to avoid accidentally giving away unlisted codes to unauthorized users.

fields.name: reports
fields.description: A set of reports for a specific guild, guild tag, or user.

args.name: endTime
args.description: Optional. A UNIX timestamp with millisecond precision representing the end time for a report range. If omitted, defaults to the current time in milliseconds.

args.name: guildID
args.description: Optional. The ID of a specific guild. Reports from that guild will be fetched.

args.name: guildName
args.description: Optional. The name of a specific guild. Must be used in conjunction with guildServerSlug and guildServerRegion to uniquely identify a guild.

args.name: guildServerSlug
args.description: Optional. The name of a specific guild. Must be used in conjunction with guildName and guildServerRegion to uniquely identify a guild.

args.name: guildServerRegion
args.description: Optional. The region for a specific guild. Must be used in conjunction with guildName and guildServerRegion to uniquely identify a guild.

args.name: guildTagID
args.description: Optional. The ID of a specific guild tag. Reports from that guild tag will be fetched. This will take precedence over all other guild arguments.

args.name: userID
args.description: Optional. The ID of a specific user. Reports from that user's personal logs will be fetched.

args.name: limit
args.description: Optional. The number of characters to retrieve per page. If omitted, defaults to 100. The maximum allowed value is 100, and minimum allowed value is 1.

args.name: page
args.description: Optional. The page of paginated data to retrieve. If omitted, defaults to the first page.

args.name: startTime
args.description: Optional. A UNIX timestamp with millisecond precision representing a start time for a report range. If omitted, defaults to 0.

args.name: zoneID
args.description: Optional. The ID of a specific zone to filter to. Reports with that zone as their default will be included.

args.name: gameZoneID
args.description: Optional. The ID of a specific game zone to filter reports to.

characterData.name: CharacterData
characterData.description: The CharacterData object enables the retrieval of single characters or filtered collections of characters.

fields.name: character
fields.description: Obtain a specific character either by id or by name/server_slug/server_region.

args.name: id
args.description: Optional. The ID of a single character to retrieve.

args.name: name
args.description: Optional. The name of a specific character. Must be used in conjunction with serverSlug and serverRegion to uniquely identify a character.

args.name: serverSlug
args.description: Optional. The slug of a specific server. Must be used in conjunction with name and serverRegion to uniquely identify a character.

args.name: serverRegion
args.description: Optional. The region for a specific character. Must be used in conjunction with name and serverRegion to uniquely identify a character.

fields.name: characters
fields.description: A collection of characters for a specific guild.

args.name: guildID
args.description: Required. The ID of a specific guild. Characters from that guild will be fetched.

args.name: limit
args.description: Optional. The number of characters to retrieve per page. If omitted, defaults to 100. The maximum allowed value is 100, and minimum allowed value is 1.

args.name: page
args.description: Optional. The page of paginated data to retrieve. If omitted, defaults to the first page.

guildData.name: GuildData
guildData.description: The GuildData object enables the retrieval of single guilds or filtered collections of guilds.

fields.name: guild
fields.description: Obtain a specific guild either by id or by name/serverSlug/serverRegion.

args.name: id
args.description: Optional. The ID of a single guild to retrieve.

args.name: name
args.description: Optional. The name of a specific guild. Must be used in conjunction with serverSlug and serverRegion to uniquely identify a guild.

args.name: serverSlug
args.description: Optional. The name of a specific guild. Must be used in conjunction with name and serverRegion to uniquely identify a guild.

args.name: serverRegion
args.description: Optional. The region for a specific guild. Must be used in conjunction with name and serverRegion to uniquely identify a guild.

fields.name: guilds
fields.description: The set of all guilds supported by the site. Can be optionally filtered to a specific server id.

args.name: limit
args.description: Optional. The number of guilds to retrieve per page. If omitted, defaults to 100. The maximum allowed value is 100, and minimum allowed value is 1.

args.name: page
args.description: Optional. The page of paginated data to retrieve. If omitted, defaults to the first page.

args.name: serverID
args.description: Optional. The ID of a specific server. If present, only guilds from that server (and any connected servers) will be fetched.

args.name: serverSlug
args.description: Optional. The slug for a specific server. Must be used in conjunction with serverRegion to uniquely identify a server. Only guilds from that server (and any connected servers) will be fetched.

args.name: serverRegion
args.description: Optional. The region for a specific server. Must be used in conjunction with serverSlug to uniquely identify a server. Only guilds from that server (and any connected servers) will be fetched.

worldData.name: WorldData
worldData.description: The world data object contains collections of data such as expansions, zones, encounters, regions, subregions, etc.

fields.name: encounter
fields.description: Obtain a specific encounter by id.

args.name: id
args.description: Required. Specify a single encounter ID to retrieve.

fields.name: expansion
fields.description: A single expansion obtained by ID.

args.name: id
args.description: Required. The ID of a single expansion to retrieve.

fields.name: expansions
fields.description: The set of all expansions supported by the site.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Obtain a specific region by its ID.

args.name: id
args.description: Required. The ID of a single region to retrieve.

fields.name: regions
fields.description: The set of all regions supported by the site.

fields.name: server
fields.description: Obtain a specific server either by id or by slug and region.

args.name: id
args.description: Optional. The ID of a single server to retrieve.

args.name: region
args.description: Optional. The compact English abbreviation for a specific region (e.g., "US"). Use in conjunction with the server slug to retrieve a single server.

args.name: slug
args.description: Optional. A server slug. Use in conjunction with the server region to retrieve a single server.

fields.name: subregion
fields.description: Obtain a specific subregion by its ID.

args.name: id
args.description: Required. The ID of a single subregion to retrieve.

fields.name: zone
fields.description: Obtain a specific zone by its ID.

args.name: id
args.description: Required. The ID of a specific zone.

fields.name: zones
fields.description: Obtain a set of all zones supported by the site.

args.name: expansion_id
args.description: Optional. The ID of a specific expansion. If omitted, the zones from all expansions will be retrieved.

rateLimitData.name: RateLimitData
rateLimitData.description: A way to obtain your current rate limit usage.

fields.name: limitPerHour
fields.description: The total amount of points this API key can spend per hour.

fields.name: pointsSpentThisHour
fields.description: The total amount of points spent during this hour.

fields.name: pointsResetIn
fields.description: The number of seconds remaining until the points reset.

userData.name: UserData
userData.description: The user data object contains basic information about users and lets you retrieve specific users (or the current user if using the user endpoint).

fields.name: user
fields.description: Obtain a specific user by id.

args.name: id
args.description: Required. Specify a single user ID to retrieve.

fields.name: currentUser
fields.description: Obtain the current user (only works with user endpoint).
